mapper.select: select id, username, password_hash, display_name, status, created_at, updated_at from sys_user where username = #{username} limit 1
select id, username, password_hash, display_name, status, created_at, updated_at from sys_user where id = #{userId} limit 1
select role_code from sys_user_role where user_id = #{userId} order by role_code asc
mapper.insert: insert into auth_refresh_token (user_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at) values (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
insert into auth_login_audit (user_id, username, success, failure_reason, trace_id, created_at) values (#{userId}, #{username}, #{success}, #{failureReason}, #{traceId}, #{createdAt})
